trucking.title: Trucking Delivery
trucking.desc: Our trucking service offers a flexible and reliable solution for domestic and regional cargo transportation. The fleet is regularly maintained, and our experienced drivers ensure that every shipment is delivered safely and on time. Each step, from cargo pickup and loading to final delivery, is managed with great attention and care. This allows us to guarantee that goods reach the correct destination in the best condition and within the committed timeframe.

customs.desc: Our customs clearance service helps businesses complete import and export procedures quickly and in full compliance with regulations. Our experienced specialists have strong knowledge of customs regulations and operational processes. We support clients in preparing documentation, submitting electronic customs declarations, and handling all required procedures. This ensures a smooth clearance process while saving time and operational costs for businesses.

air.title: Air Freight

We cooperate with various airlines and international logistics partners to provide flexible transportation solutions tailored to each customer’s needs. In addition to transportation, we also assist with packaging consultation and preparation of necessary shipping documents. This ensures that all cargo is handled safely and arrives at its destination according to schedule.

sea.title: Sea Freight
sea.desc: Our sea freight service provides an efficient and cost-effective logistics solution for international shipments. With an extensive network of global shipping partners, we are capable of handling a wide range of cargo with different scales and requirements. Our operations are carefully managed to ensure that goods are transported safely and according to schedule. We also support shipment tracking and documentation handling to help clients easily monitor and manage their cargo.

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about starting global fulfillment with VietGlobal.
faq.q1: Do I need to hold inventory?
faq.a1: No. For POD and dropshipping models, products are produced or sourced on demand after customer orders. For brands holding inventory, we offer scalable warehousing.
faq.q2: Which markets can you ship to today?
faq.a2: Our core routes span Southeast Asia, the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), European Union countries, the UK, and the United States.
faq.q3: How does POD fulfillment pricing work?
faq.a3: Pricing consists of the product blank/manufacturing cost + printing/handling fee + international shipping rate. All rates are transparent with no hidden costs.
faq.q4: Can I use my own branding on packaging?
faq.a4: Yes, absolutely. We support custom poly mailers, branded stickers, neck labels, and personalized thank-you cards.
faq.q5: How long does cross-border delivery usually take?
faq.a5: Direct line express cross-border delivery typically takes between 5 to 8 business days depending on destination market.
faq.q6: Which platforms do you integrate with?
faq.a6: We integrate directly with Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, WooCommerce, and Etsy with automatic order & tracking sync.

cta.headline: Ready to scale your fulfillment globally?
cta.copy: No upfront commitment required — share your target volume and markets, we'll configure an optimized fulfillment plan.
